title: C4 Check Result
description: Deterministic rule evaluation result (Guide §1.3, §3.4 C4, §12.2). Distinct from document verification status.

rule_id.description: Unique rule identifier (e.g. DEMO-DOC-001, DEMO-DATE-001, DEMO-INTAKE-001, R-EXP-001)

rule_version.description: Version of the rule evaluated (e.g. '1.0.0' or 1)

status.description: Rule evaluation state. Never overloaded with document verification or workflow states.

category.description: Category of the check or discrepancy

observed.description: Observed value from submitted document or application

expected.description: Expected value or condition required by rule

advisory.description: All automated checks are advisory decision-support inputs for officers

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of the check outcome

evidence.description: Supporting evidence. Comparison rules must attach evidence for both sides.

simulated.description: Explicitly true when rule runs against synthetic records or mock adapters
